Lemma
[Shi's estimates for Type A solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0155 ↗ def:chow-iv-type-a-singular-solution 1. ch30:30.2\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

If a complete Type A solution has constant $M$ and exponent $r$, then for all $k,\ell \geq 0$ and $\eta \in (0,(\omega -\alpha )/2]$ there is $C_{n,k,\ell ,\eta ,M}<\infty $ such that \[ \left| rac{\partial ^k}{\partial t^k} abla ^\ell \Rm ight|(x,t) \leq rac{C_{n,k,\ell ,\eta ,M}}{(\omega -t)^{(1+k+\ell /2)r}} \] on $\mathcal M imes [\alpha +\eta ,\omega )$. In particular, $| abla R|\leq C(\omega -t)^{-3r/2}$ there.
